mac:
s=$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/killu42/tex-setup/main/mac.sh) && eval "$s" &&
brew install --cask mactex && tex_update
intel:
tex_tmp=$(mktemp -d) &&
curl -fL https://mirror.ctan.org/systems/mac/mactex/MacTeX.pkg \
  -o "$tex_tmp/MacTeX.pkg" &&
spctl --assess --type install "$tex_tmp/MacTeX.pkg" &&
sudo installer -pkg "$tex_tmp/MacTeX.pkg" -target / &&
sudo /Library/TeX/texbin/tlmgr update --self --all &&
rm "$tex_tmp/MacTeX.pkg" && rmdir "$tex_tmp"
linux:
sudo apt update && sudo apt install texlive-latex-extra texlive-lang-german \
texlive-fonts-recommended biber latexmk texstudio
windows:
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/killu42/tex-setup/main/win.ps1 | iex
winget install --id MiKTeX.MiKTeX -e --scope user -s winget --no-upgrade; Update-TeX
